about.title: About Atlante
about.what: Atlante is the program Zeta3 uses to manage projects, clients and work items.
about.based_on: It is based on Plane, free software licensed under the GNU AGPL 3.0. Zeta3 modified it and maintains the changes, under the same license.
about.source_access: The code of every version of Atlante is public, under Plane's AGPL-3.0 license.

auth.invited_sign_up: Create an account to work with your team.
auth.invited_sign_in: Sign in to work with your team.

phases.heading: Template and roles
phases.template_in_use: The project follows the {name} template. Rules are bound to the role of each phase: rename, recolor and move the phases above without breaking them.
phases.no_template: The project follows no template: phases do not change people and delivery dates.
phases.apply_explanation: Starting phases without tasks take the name and color of the template phases; missing ones are added. Nothing is deleted and existing tasks stay where they are.
phases.roles_description: Phases give the work to these people. A change holds for tasks entering a phase from now on.
phases.rules_description: When a task enters a phase, executor and delivery date change by themselves.
phases.executor_info: The executor changes by itself when the task moves to another phase: the project roles decide it.

home.to_assign_hint: the tasks you are responsible for

phases.missing_phases: The template has new phases the project does not have yet: {phases}.
phases.template_failed: Project created, but the template was not applied: apply it from the settings, in the Phases page.

approval.waiting_text: Sent {to} on {sent} by {who}. The client has until {due} included to approve it or ask for changes.
approval.reminder_title: Waiting for the client's approval: {days} days left
approval.reminder_title_one: Waiting for the client's approval: 1 day left
approval.reminder_text: {reminder} is the reminder day: remind the client. Without an answer by {due}, from {after} the work is approved (article 9.1).
approval.consent_title: Waiting for the client's explicit approval
approval.consent_text: Strategy, brand and site presentations need an explicit yes. Sent on {sent}; after 15 days without an answer the client must be reminded.
approval.consent_late: 15 days without an answer: the client's yes is needed, the task stays.
approval.rounds_over_title: The included revision rounds are used
approval.rounds_over_text: The contract {with} includes {included} revision rounds and with this one all are used. Further changes are paid.
approval.approved_text: {client} approved the work on {date} (recorded by {who}). The task moved to {phase}.
approval.changes_text: {who} recorded the client's changes on {date}. {rounds} The task goes back to {phase} with the same urgency.
approval.changes_extra: An extra, paid round starts: the contract includes {included}.
approval.changes_micro: Micro fix: the round does not count.
approval.hint: Until the portal, the person following the client records the answer here.
approval.ready_title: Ready to send to the client
approval.ready_text: The work is ready{for}. Send it to the client and press "Sent to the client": the 15 days start from that day.
approval.ready_text_consent: The work is ready{for}. Send it and press "Sent to the client". It needs the client's yes: no silent consent.
approval.silent_text: 15 days passed without an answer: by article 9.1 the work is approved. Confirm and the task moves to {phase}.
approval.silent_done_text: On {date}, after 15 days without an answer, {who} confirmed the approval (article 9.1). The task moved to {phase}.
